invariants: The statement is the ONLY element. Adding a subtitle is the commonest way to ruin this slide: two things to read stops it being a pause.
Central axis. The kit's statement slides are all left-aligned with art beside them; here the type sits IN the field.
The field never narrows the contrast. Navy on cream with a texture between is a §3.5 question, not a taste one.
